items.title: UK’s Humanoid partners with Bosch to mass-produce HMND robots for industries
items.titleCn: UK’s Humanoid partners with Bosch to mass-produce HMND robots for industries
items.summary: UK-based Humanoid has partnered with Bosch to mass-produce its HMND humanoid robots for industrial use, following successful proof-of-concept trials in 2026.
items.summaryCn: UK-based Humanoid has partnered with Bosch to mass-produce its HMND humanoid robots for industrial use, following successful proof-of-concept trials in 2026.

items.title: GE Vernova to acquire Robotech Automation to expand robotics integration
items.titleCn: GE Vernova to acquire Robotech Automation to expand robotics integration
items.summary: GE Vernova has signed an agreement to acquire Robotech Automation, a systems integrator with 35 employees based in Longueuil, Quebec, to accelerate its robotics and automation capabilities.
